basic_details.job_title: DDPMoD Deputy Planning Officer Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Directorate of Planning and Coordination, Department of Defence Production (DDP), Ministry of Defence, Government of India, will fill 01 (One) post of Deputy Planning Officer (General) in Pay Level-12 (7th CPC) by transfer on deputation or on short term contract. Officers of the All India Services, Central Civil Services Group 'A', DRDO, PSUs and serving Lt Col/Cdr/Wg Cdr officers may apply through their administrative authorities in the attached proforma, so that the application reaches New Delhi within 45 days of the date of issue of the circular (25 November 2026), that is by about 9 Ja

important_dates.application to reach: Within 45 days of issue – about 9 January 2027 (45 days from 25 November 2026)

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the Bio-Data Proforma attached to the circular only.
Get the application recommended by the concerned administrative authorities.
Attach the ACR Dossier or authenticated copies of the last 5 years' ACRs/APARs.
The administrative authority must certify that the particulars furnished are correct and that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the officer.
Furnish an undertaking that the candidature will not be withdrawn.

Forward the application so as to reach Jt Dir (Adm & Coord), Directorate of Planning & Coordination, Ministry of Defence, 5th Floor, Room No. 501, C Block, Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi-110001 within 45 days of the date of issue of the circular.

Bio-Data Proforma: name and address, date of birth, date of retirement, educational qualifications, desirable qualifications held, relevant experience (maximum 100 words), employment details in chronological order, nature of present employment, deputation/contract details, cadre controlling authority, pay revision details, total emoluments, SC/ST status, place of posting and contact details.
ACR Dossier or authenticated copies of the last 5 years' ACRs/APARs.
Integrity Certificate and Declaration regarding Penalty (last ten years), signed by the competent authority.
Certificate from the administrative authority on correctness of particulars and no pending disciplinary/vigilance case.
Record of service for Service Officers, wherever considered desirable; supporting documents on analogous post for PSU applicants.
important_instructions: Only officers who can be spared for the full tenure in the event of their selection should be forwarded. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Applications in any format other than the attached proforma will not be in order. The circular is uploaded on www.ddpmod.gov.in under the hyperlink 'Vacancy & Circular'; Service HQrs and DoO(C&S) are also asked to upload it. Contact telephone printed on the circular: 23072314.

content_sections.heading: About DDP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Department of Defence Production works under the Ministry of Defence. The post is in its Directorate of Planning and Coordination, 5th Floor, C-Block, Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi – 110001. The circular says the post "would fall vacant shortly" and has been sent to the Service Headquarters, HQ IDS, DRDO, DGQA, the cadre controlling authorities and all Ministries/Departments and DPSUs.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not name an educational degree. Eligibility is based on the applicant's service. Any one of the following categories may apply: Transfer on deputation: suitable officers of the All India Services, or officers holding analogous posts in Central Civil Services Group 'A' or in DRDO. OR short term contract: officers holding analogous posts from Public Sector Undertakings. PSU applicants must submit documents showing that they hold an analogous post in their parent cadre. OR serving Service Officers holding the substantive rank of Lt Col/Cdr/Wg Cdr in the Indian Army/Navy/Air Force respectively. An officer applying for the deputation post must have a residual service of 05 years with effect from the date of issue of the vacancy circular. The notice does not mention a separate age limit. Overall performance of the officer must be well above average. The officer should not have been permanently superseded for promotion. Proficient in DAP 2020 and defence capital acquisition procedures. Should preferably be familiar with policy/procedural matters in the field of defence production, indigenization, 'Make-in-India' in the defence sector and the Defence Procurement Procedure (DPP). Qualified on DSSC/TSOC. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is in Pay Level-12 as per the 7th CPC. The pay of the officer selected on deputation will be regulated as per existing government orders/instructions. Service Officers on deputation shall continue to draw their pay and allowances from their respective CDAs if selected. The period of deputation, as per the existing Recruitment Rules of the Dte of P&C, shall not ordinarily exceed four (4) years. It may be extended in public interest as per rules. Deputation in any other ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment is counted in the total period of deputation.

content_sections.heading: DDP Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The job specifications printed for the Deputy Planning Officer (General) are: Collection, study and analysis of information relating to Capital Acquisition by Service Headquarters in DDP and in other Ministries, to obtain an up-to-date picture of the likely availability of products, technologies and production capacities relevant to defence items in the country. Technical assessment of the qualitative requirement and AON of proposals forwarded by the Service Headquarters for categorisation, and advice to the department for formulation of DDP's comments. Compilation of capital acquisition proposals coming before the Categorization Committees, Defence Production Board and Defence Acquisition Council, in coordination with wings in DDP, MoD and Service HQs/HQ IDS. Important/key policy issues related to Defence Production. Representing DDP in Feasibility studies/IPMT/PFT for the "Make" Projects. Progress of projects that become the responsibility of the division, and organising meetings/briefings on categorization of Capital Acquisition Proposals and key policy issues relating to defence production.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised in DDP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: One post, 01 (One) Deputy Planning Officer (General), in the Dte of Planning and Coordination, DDP, Ministry of Defence.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach within 45 days of the date of issue of the circular (25 November 2026), which works out to about 9 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Deputy Planning Officer (General) post?
faq.answer: Officers of the All India Services or analogous posts in CCS Group 'A' or DRDO, officers holding analogous posts in PSUs (on short term contract), or serving Lt Col/Cdr/Wg Cdr officers of the Army/Navy/Air Force respectively.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for DDP Deputy Planning Officer (General)?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Level-12 as per the 7th CPC; pay on deputation is regulated as per existing government orders, and Service Officers draw pay from their respective CDAs.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the attached proforma, recommended by your administrative authority, with ACRs/APARs of the last 5 years, to Jt Dir (Adm & Coord), Room No. 501, C Block, Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi-110001.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation shall not ordinarily exceed four (4) years and may be extended in public interest as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. How much residual service is required?
faq.answer: The officer must have a residual service of 05 years with effect from the date of issue of the vacancy circular.

faq.question: Q8. Can I withdraw my application later?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature, and an undertaking to this effect must be furnished.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications?
faq.answer: Well above average performance with no permanent supersession, proficiency in DAP 2020, preferably familiarity with defence production policy, indigenization, Make-in-India and DPP, and DSSC/TSOC qualification.
